Highlights:
THE ULTIMATE ZOTAC GAMING GPU 

AMP Extreme Holo

The ultimate ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 30 Series GPU is here with the AMP Extreme Holo. Redesigned with function over form, the AMP Extreme Holo is the culmination of all current 30 Series features and design shifted towards performance.

ADVANCED COOLING

 A more refined IceStorm 2.0 cooling system is purpose-built for wider coverage to keep the GPU cooler and running stronger, with enhancements in the visible and in what lies underneath.

PASS-THRU AIRFLOW

More airflow exit routes across the GPU design including a direct pass-thru airflow vent, which enables faster heat exhaust, reduces trapped heat, and reduces airflow turbulence for overall improved noise and thermal performance. 

MAXIMUM AIRFLOW 

The ZOTAC GAMING AMP Extreme Holo features the largest ever set of fans used with triple 100mm fans for maximum airflow dynamics. 

11-BLADE DESIGN

The 11-blade fan design increases static pressure and airflow by up to 10% compared to previous generation design. 

DESIGNED TO COVER

 A wider aluminum fin-stack array heatsink sectioned in up to 3 groups, paired with up to eight copper heat pipes span beyond the length of the graphics card board to extract and distribute more heat, more efficiently for maximum cooling performance.

SECTIONED

The optimized heatsink structure is sectioned into 3 distinct partitions to fully enfold the heatpipes for overall increased contact points with the aluminum heatsink fin-array. 

WIDE COLD-BLOCK 

A large copper surface baseplate ensure full coverage of the GPU surface area. 

MORE SURFACE CONTACT

The heatpipes shift into a vertical layout as it crosses over the large aluminum surface area baseplate which contact the GPU core. The vertical layout increases heatpipe to cold-block surface area contact by up to 72%, pushing for even more heat extraction. 

8 HEATPIPES 

The AMP Extreme Holo features 8 precision machined copper heatpipes. The highest count of heatpipes used in the history of ZOTAC GAMING GPUs to ensure maximum heat extraction. 

COMPOSITE HEATPIPES

Each copper heatpipe is made of composite layers consisting of a thicker envelope and a grooved wick with a multi-channel working fluid. 

 

 

WIDTH 30.56 mm

THICKER

Sitting at a 3-slot GPU, the overall heatsink thickness increases 10% for even more surface area and stronger heat dissipation. 

 

 

CRITICAL COMPONENT CONTACT

Memory and VRM modules make contact with the heatsink via premium thermal pads for cooling beyond just the GPU.
